map.PA 和 SPF 区别？: What is the difference between PA and SPF?
map.SPF 主要防 UV-B（晒伤），PA 主要防 UV-A（光老化和黑），两者都要: SPF mainly protects against UV-B (sunburn) while PA mainly protects against UV-A (photoaging and tanning), and both matter.
map.SPF 越高越久不用补吗？: The higher the SPF, the longer before you need to reapply?
map.→ 打开防晒系数SPF/PA计算工具: -> Open the sunscreen factor SPF/PA calculator tool
map.不是。SPF 是强度不是时长，出汗、摩擦、出油都会削弱，一般 2 小时补一次。: No. SPF is intensity, not duration; sweat, friction and oil all weaken it, so it normally needs reapplying every 2 hours.
